# Awesome LLMOps Platforms

A curated list of **144 open-source tools for running LLM applications in production**: tracing, evaluation, gateways, guardrails and prompt management.

Every table is sorted by GitHub stars, highest first. A GitHub Action refreshes the stars, licenses and dates every week. Last refresh: **2026-10-19**.

This list covers tools you can run yourself. It leaves out papers, courses, model benchmarks and agent frameworks. Other lists cover those well.

## Contents

- [All-in-one LLMOps platforms](#all-in-one-llmops-platforms) (21)
- [Observability and tracing](#observability-and-tracing) (26)
- [OpenTelemetry instrumentation](#opentelemetry-instrumentation) (3)
- [Evaluation and testing](#evaluation-and-testing) (33)
- [Red teaming and security testing](#red-teaming-and-security-testing) (5)
- [Guardrails](#guardrails) (9)
- [LLM gateways and routers](#llm-gateways-and-routers) (30)
- [API and agent gateways with AI support](#api-and-agent-gateways-with-ai-support) (8)
- [Prompt management](#prompt-management) (9)

**How to read the tables.** *archived* means the owner archived the repo on GitHub. *inactive* means no push in the last 12 months. **†** means the main code is source-available rather than under an OSI-approved open-source license, so check the terms before you use it commercially. "+ EE" means an open-source core with a separately licensed enterprise folder.
